gameDescriptionHtml:
Store items, earn money, and upgrade your warehouse! You play a small, cute robot who takes care of the belongings of your customers with a gravity gun – but be careful not to break anything!

Game Features

  • Decorate to your heart’s content! – Make it cozy for yourself and your customers. Hang up pictures, plant beautiful plants, and place a comfy couch for them!
  • Upgrade your gravity gun! – Improve your gravity gun so the battery lasts longer, recharges faster, or can lift heavier items!
  • Build your warehouse! – Construct small storage units to organize your items and set up shelves. How about a little cart or a box? No problem for a few credits!
  • Earn your vacation! – The Isle awaits you, and all your robot friends. Earn enough money for your well-deserved break on The Isle.
  • Discover the secrets! – Find hidden places in your neighborhood.
  • Meet your customers! – Get to know new and exciting characters over time and see what they’ll bring you! Some of our characters are even created by the community.
